name: Kelud Western Flank Alpha
rationale: E080 Target 1 + E097 anomaly convergence (65%). Western flank = downslope from Kelud summit. River confluence = settlement attractor. E013 high suitability. Zero known sites within 10 km.
expected_finds: Cultural layer with charcoal, ceramic, phytoliths at 3-5m depth
falsification: If sterile volcanic sediment with no cultural indicators at all depths (0-8m)

name: Arjuno Northern Slope
rationale: E080 Target 3. Northern slope = lahar channel zone. High settlement suitability (moderate slope, river proximity). E097 anomaly overlap. Inscription desert zone (E169).
expected_finds: Brick fragments, ceramic, or cultural soil horizon at 4-7m
falsification: If no anthropogenic signal in 10m core

name: Singosari Axis Extension
rationale: Along axis from Dwarapala (3.5 mm/yr calibration) toward Kelud. Pre-Singosari settlement likely existed here. Dwarapala proves 1.85m burial in 755 years = sites from 400 CE should be at 2-4m.
expected_finds: Stone foundations (umpak) or ceramic scatter at 2-3m depth
falsification: If GPR shows only volcanic stratigraphy with no reflectors

name: Brantas River Confluence
rationale: E156 Double Erasure: Sunda Shelf populations entered Java through Brantas system. River confluence = maximum settlement probability. E166 Zone B (GPR-detectable). No known pre-Hindu sites in this zone.
expected_finds: Cultural layer (charcoal + ceramic) at river terrace level, 2.5-4.5m depth
falsification: If alluvial sequence with no cultural interruption

name: Penanggungan Western Valley
rationale: Penanggungan = sacred mountain with 81 known candi on slopes. E065 Zone A 17.9x overrepresented. If 81 temples exist on the surface, associated settlements must exist buried nearby. E153: 81% non-temple sites within 10km of candi.
expected_finds: Settlement debris (ceramic, brick fragments, charcoal) associated with temple-building communities
falsification: If only volcanic stratigraphy around known candi sites
